title: b7z9.53(c): combined pre-TX gate for authenticated identity + replay + RPL context + SFN state
description: Child of b7z9.53 item (3): C enforces the full pre-TX chain in lichen_link_tx.c:63-106 (-ENOKEY/-EBUSY/latch: authenticated link identity + replay state + initialized RPL/DODAG context + valid time/SFN). Rust tdma_scheduler.rs is slot-math only — wire the same chain check at the Rust TX entry (stack.rs send path), with tests for each rejection reason mirroring the C error mapping.
